aboutMe.metaTitle: About Eun, web publisher | My story
aboutMe.metaDescription: Meet Eun, a web publisher working with HTML, SCSS and Vue. Discover his personality, beliefs and the eun. logo, a signature built around consistency and small details.
aboutMe.intro: I’m Eun, a web publisher working with HTML, SCSS, and Vue. Here’s a little about my personality, a saying I remember, and the logo I designed.
aboutMe.personalityTitle: I like to try things myself.
aboutMe.personalityDescription: My MBTI is ENTJ. When something interests me, I try it myself. Once I decide to do something, I make a plan and work through it.
aboutMe.beliefSource: — My middle-school technology and home economics teacher
aboutMe.beliefDescription: I heard this in a middle-school class. It still comes to mind when I’m tempted to put something off.
aboutMe.identityDescription: “eun” is my surname in lowercase, followed by a red dot. It’s the name I use to sign this portfolio.
aboutMe.logoDescription: Eun’s lowercase eun wordmark with matching letter heights and a red full stop
aboutMe.identityRhythmDescription: I kept the letters lowercase and balanced their weight and spacing. I wanted the logo to be easy to read and sit comfortably with the rest of the page.
aboutMe.identityDotDescription: Before I finish a screen, I take another look at the spacing and button states. The red dot is a small reminder to give those details some extra care.
aboutMe.roleAnswer: Eun is a web publisher who builds responsive interfaces with HTML and SCSS and develops UI with Vue 3 and Nuxt 3. Work examples are available in the professional and personal project archives.
